morbi.headline: Morbi ceramics faces export contraction and fuel cost hikes despite container freight relief.
what_changed: Iran war disruptions caused a Rs 3,589 crore drop in ceramic exports over six months.
Propane usage resumed in the cluster, but prices rose by Rs 3/kg to reach Rs 104/kg.
Ocean container freight rates dropped by up to 50 percent, offering shipping cost relief.
stress_signals: Ceramic exports plummeted by Rs 3,589 crore over six months due to the war in Iran [19f71f3185bc].
Industrial propane gas prices increased by Rs 3/kg to Rs 104/kg, raising production cost pressures [9e8c549b7c05], [3d9aa30057b8].
Tile industry faces broader export market challenges alongside rising overall cost pressures [895aa138960b].
improvement_signals: Container freight rates dropped by up to 50 percent for Morbi ceramics exporters [d6c30857de2c].
what_to_watch: Further escalations in industrial propane prices above Rs 104/kg and fuel cost impact on unit margins.
Export order book recovery and receivables turnover for units trading with Middle East destinations.
Working capital utilization spikes among export-oriented tile and sanitaryware manufacturers.

surat.headline: Mixed signals in Surat as diamond demand rebounds despite textile liquidity and payment distress.
what_changed: Textile weavers face severe financial distress and payment delays, prompting production cuts and protests.
Diamond sector exhibits signs of recovery and early reopenings despite raw material shortages and past job losses.
Government reduced Textile PLI turnover threshold by 50% and extended the scheme to FY 2033-34.
Embroidery labor disputes ended following an agreement between unit owners and workers.
stress_signals: Sayan weavers planned a collective vacation to cut fabric production by 60 crore meters amid a financial crisis [297b184838d2].
Weavers staged protests over outstanding payment dues exceeding 200 days ahead of Diwali [774ba602b06e], while SMA warned of a payment crisis threatening small traders [e0787797133b].

Textile traders face payment fraud and defaults, including ₹1.5 crore in unpaid dues to 10 jobworkers [6a3068dc8bf1], organized fraud gangs [421d4bf835f5], and arrests of buyers for ₹22 lakh fraud [f699b1f05b5e].
Rough diamond shortages forced early pre-Diwali closures [b65b93c4b724], alongside a tragic suicide of a local diamond merchant [9edf027a29a8] and 100,000 reported sector job losses [1bcd949a2599].
improvement_signals: Diamond cutting and polishing units plan early reopenings and extended operations until Dhanteras driven by rising demand [bd78e4a130ff, e533595d0815, d6a824e747af].
Lab-grown diamond (LGD) demand increased ahead of Diwali, leading to a 10% bonus for workers [751cd1661531].
Embroidery worker movement ended after reaching an agreement with unit owners [3a495ae0b3ee].
what_to_watch: Receivables ageing beyond 90-200 days in MMF weaving and job-work accounts to flag potential NPA slippages.
Inventory and working capital utilization in diamond units navigating rough diamond supply bottlenecks.
Adoption rate of the relaxed PLI scheme thresholds among MSME textile units in Surat.
Impact of SGCCI MoUs in Morocco on local textile export order volumes.
